OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) that benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings together the world’s leading scientists, engineers, and business professionals to develop and deploy transformative AI technologies.

Our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization helps customers understand, adopt, and scale OpenAI’s products and platform. Revenue Operations partners closely with Sales, Finance, and People teams to drive planning, performance management, and operational excellence across the business. The Planning team supports key revenue planning cycles and helps align resources, incentives, and execution against company priorities.

About the Role

We are seeking a Compensation Operations Manager to support and execute the operational infrastructure behind OpenAI's global variable compensation programs across Sales, Technical Success, Partnerships, and other GTM teams.

This role is focused on driving scalable commission policies and operational excellence. You'll lead the development of best-in-class commission processes, oversee policy implementation, establish robust audit practices, and support the field through issue triage and resolution. In close partnership with Revenue Operations, Finance, Total Rewards, HRIS, and GTM Systems, you'll ensure our compensation programs are accurate, compliant, scalable, and deliver a seamless experience for the field.

The ideal candidate combines deep compensation operations expertise with strong systems thinking, operational rigor, attention to detail, and a customer-service mindset.

You'll be responsible for:

 - Administer compensation plans, quotas, credits, adjustments, exceptions, and payout processes.

 - Collaborate with a cross-functional team of engineers, HRBPs, recruiters, researchers, product managers, designers, and people in operations to create cutting-edge products

jobs.title: Enterprise Systems Manager, Recruiting Systems
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s People Experience & Technology (PXT) team owns the core people platform that powers worker, recruiting, contingent, approvals, and lifecycle workflows across the company. PXT is responsible for operating Workday, Ashby, and related people systems as governed, reliable sources of truth, while building the controls, monitoring, documentation, and auditability required to support scale.

About the Role

We’re hiring an Enterprise Systems Manager, Recruiting Systems to help own and harden OpenAI’s recruiting platform, with a focus on Ashby and its connected workflows. This is a hands-on systems role for someone who can translate recruiting process problems into governed, durable fixes through configuration, workflow design, access controls, documentation, reporting guardrails, and integration partnership.

You will work at the boundary of Recruiting, HR Operations, Legal, Compensation, Analytics, IT, and PXT to improve the reliability and control health of recruiting workflows. The right person is comfortable going deep in system design while also driving rollout, adoption, and operational clarity.

In this role you will:

 - Own specific recruiting workflow domains in Ashby and adjacent tools, including stages, fields, permissions, approvals, templates, and configuration standards.

 - Partner on high-priority remediation work across start dates, offers, approvals, integrations, auditability, data integrity, and workflow controls.

 - Design and implement governed workflow changes that balance recruiter usability with reporting trust, downstream integration reliability, and control requirements.

 - Establish and maintain guardrails such as required and conditional fields, stage definitions, role-based permissions, approval logic, validation patterns, and change standards.

 - Drive durable fixes for recurring operational issues by identifying root causes and resolving them through configuration, automation, documentation, or process redesign.
